exposure: Feeding patterns (exclusive breastfeeding, mixed feeding, cow's milk formula)
outcome: Serum zonulin levels (as a marker of intestinal permeability)
cohort: One hundred fifty-seven full-term, healthy infants, born after an uncomplicated pregnancy, enrolled within 72-96 hours of life.
finding: Different feeding patterns (exclusive breastfeeding, mixed feeding, and cow's milk formula) were not associated with serum zonulin levels in healthy infants at 3-4 months of age.
